description: Mine ore in the current sector right now (the cargo gain is in the reply); also auto-starts a MINING mission if none is active. Ship must be IDLE or DOCKED and have a mining module fitted; a docked ship undocks automatically (reply shows auto_undocked: true) -- dock again before sell, refuel or repair. Takes no parameters; the ore follows from the sector. Subject to the 10-second action tick (RATE_LIMITED if called too fast).

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

name: mine
